$comment: Fonts of Leitvia Studio that a token set can name, Latin subset, in the fontFace format of theme.json with src relative to this folder. Dtcg::bundled_fonts() adds them after the fonts of the theme, so a face of the theme always wins. SIL OFL 1.1; readme.txt names each font and where its terms are. From Fontsource 5.3.0: Libre Franklin, one variable file for the weights 100 to 900; Young Serif, its one regular cut declared for 400 to 900, so headings of any weight show it without faux bold. Open Sans in open-sans/ is for the admin screens only and not listed here.
